$comment: Sounds made outside the generators (docs/MEDIA_BUILD.md 4: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX), registered by tools/audio/add_sfx.py and read by build.py. An id that is also a generator keeps its generated file as <id>_synth.wav (manifest id <id>_synth, pack media, the entry's fallback), so a swap stays reversible by ear. Edit by running add_sfx.py, not by hand.

bell_thirteenth.intent: The Thirteenth Bell, the cracked bell of the Stacks: one hard strike of a huge cracked bronze bell, sour and rattling, choked short (the cold open's thirteenth toll, the ending, the Stacks). Made in Runway; the generated bell stays as bell_thirteenth_synth.
bell_thirteenth.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: One hard strike of a huge cracked bronze bell, the crack makes it sour and rattling, choked short with no ringing tail, then silence (1 s asked)

bell_peal.intent: Willowmere's twelve bells pealing together (the ending). Made in Runway; the generated peal stays as bell_peal_synth.
bell_peal.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: Twelve church bells pealing together in a joyful round, bright bronze, heard across a river town at night (4 s asked)

chest_open.intent: A chest opens (the field's chests). Made in Runway; the generated one stays as chest_open_synth.
chest_open.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: A small wooden treasure chest lid creaks open quickly with a latch click, fantasy RPG (1 s asked)

level_up_sparkle.intent: The level-up sparkle under the level_up jingle. Made in Runway; the generated one stays as level_up_sparkle_synth.
level_up_sparkle.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: A bright rising magical sparkle shimmer, a short glittering chime, fantasy level up (1 s asked)

bookmark_use.intent: The Bookmark is used in the Deep Stacks (bookmarkFlow: the reading is banked). Runway; page_flutter until the media pack arrives.
bookmark_use.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: A silk ribbon bookmark slides into a heavy old book and the book closes with a soft thump (1 s asked)

chest_blue.source: Runway, ElevenLabs Text to SFX, 2026-11-02, prompt: A heavy iron-bound chest unlatches with a deep clunk and opens with a magical glowing shimmer (2 s asked)
